label: Disable shader
detail: Clear the screen shader immediately; explicit Restore recovers the snapshot.

label: Grayscale · 15 second trial
detail: Rec.709 luma, preserves alpha. Reverts in 15 seconds unless Keep effect; GPU qualification pending.

label: Readable warm · 15 second trial
detail: Gentle constant green/blue reduction, preserves alpha. Reverts in 15 seconds unless Keep effect.

label: Cool
detail: Gentle blue-biased filter; independent timed rollback.

label: Sepia
detail: Classic three-channel sepia transform; independent timed rollback.

label: Soft contrast
detail: Reduce RGB contrast around mid-gray; independent timed rollback.

label: Dim
detail: Reduce RGB brightness, preserving alpha; independent timed rollback.
